title: An Entire Reservation Just Got Evacuated
script: An entire reservation, evacuated? The Bench Fire ripped through the Warm Springs Reservation in Central Oregon, and in less than a week it swallowed over 60,000 acres. Six homes are already gone. Five other buildings too. Officials issued Level 3 'Go Now' orders for the entire community — no packing, no deciding, just leaving. Nearly 600 firefighters are on it right now, and containment sits at just 3 percent. This isn't an isolated blaze either — Oregon has more than a million acres burning statewide, with thousands more under the same evacuation order. For a tribal community that's called Warm Springs home for generations, the fire didn't ask permission. So how do you rebuild a whole reservation from 3 percent contained?
